bot_settings.faq_delete_body: Zayna will no longer use this answer for similar questions.
bot_settings.wizard_desc: Opens WhatsApp with your Zayna number to relaunch setup or update business rules through chat.
bot_settings.help_subtitle: Overview of your WhatsApp assistant's capabilities.
bot_settings.help_book_body: When a client writes "I want highlights tomorrow", Zayna reads the team's real-time availability (cross-checking existing bookings, declared time-off, and which staff handles which service), proposes the 3 best slots, manages multi-step services (color + cut + blowout), confirms and creates the appointment in the agenda. To modify or cancel, the client just messages her — no intervention from you.
bot_settings.help_memory_body: Level 1 — Identity: name, preferred language, birthday (collected at first contact). Level 2 — Sensitivity: hair/skin type, declared allergies, preferences (no PPD coloring, never coconut oil, etc.). Level 3 — History: last 5 visits with dates, staff and services. On every message, Zayna reloads these 3 layers to personalize her reply — she greets "Hi Sarah" and proposes Tuesday 2pm if that's her usual slot.
bot_settings.help_allergens_body: Level 1 — Client allergies: Zayna asks at first contact ("do you have any known allergies?") and remembers them. On every booking, she cross-checks and blocks if there's a match with a risk service. Level 2 — Owner list (you): the list of allergens to systematically watch (PPD, formaldehyde, ammonia, thiomersal, resorcinol…). Zayna asks pre-booking when these are involved, even if the client never mentioned them. Match → booking refused + alternative offered + escalated to you.
bot_settings.help_smart_body: Smart slots: Zayna detects recurring patterns (3 visits on Saturday 11am) and proposes that slot first on next bookings. Upsell: based on the main service, she suggests the most profitable add-on (cut → blowout at -20%). Continuity: she keeps the same staff member as previous visits when possible, otherwise explains why the change.
bot_settings.help_escalate_body: When Zayna detects a sensitive case (complaint, off-catalog request, unknown allergy, negative client sentiment in analysis), she sends you a compact summary on WhatsApp + 2 buttons "Reply via Zayna" (you dictate, Zayna formats and sends to client) or "Contact directly" (Zayna gives you the client number + steps aside). The conversation stays in handover mode until you close it.
bot_settings.help_learn_body: When you reply to a client through Zayna in handover mode (using the "Reply via Zayna" button), she stores the question + your answer + language + converts the question into a semantic vector. On every future similar question (even worded differently), Zayna searches her base by cosine similarity ≥ 0.85 and replies directly without asking you. You can review the list, clean it and delete what no longer applies from this page.
bot_settings.help_proactive_body: Birthday (Marketing): Zayna wishes + sends gift offer to clients who opted into marketing, on the day. 90-day reactivation (Marketing): re-engages 1× clients silent for 3 months. Google review (Utility): D+1 after a completed appointment, offers leaving a review for a discount on the next service. Slot freed (Utility): when a booking is canceled and a client was on the waitlist, instant WhatsApp alert. Hard cap of 20 proactive sends/day to prevent spam.
bot_settings.help_owner_body: From your own WhatsApp, you can ask Zayna: "April revenue?", "tomorrow's bookings?", "who's free Friday 3pm?", "how much did I spend on costs this month?", "top 5 VIP clients?". She answers instantly without you having to open the app.
bot_settings.help_safety_body: The "Pause Zayna" toggle immediately stops processing of ALL incoming messages: no new message gets a reply, no proactive is sent. Active conversations remain intact but frozen. Reactivate in 1 click when ready. Useful when a bug is detected or for an exceptional event (unexpected closure).
bot_settings.paused_desc: No incoming messages are being processed.
bot_settings.active_desc: Pause the assistant in 1 click in case of emergency.
bot_settings.pause_confirm_body: No messages will be processed until reactivation. Active conversations are frozen.
